problems: No merger of Morgan Stanley Direct Lending Fund (CIK 1782524) is described in any filing excerpt. The N-14 8C (0001104659-22-057074), N-14/A and N-14 8C/A are an exchange offer of registered 4.500% Notes due 2027 for restricted notes, not a fund merger; the RW (0001104659-22-070616) withdraws Amendment No. 1 to that N-14 only to refile it as N-14 8C/A. The other filings are 8-Ks (credit facility, drawdowns, officers, dividends, earnings dates) and annual-meeting proxies (directors and auditor only). The fund's cover pages show no exchange listing until the 8-K filed 2024-02-15, which shows MSDL on The New York Stock Exchange.
